Current work

Data Scientist · Wearable R&D

CyterX Pty Ltd · October 2026–present · Part-time

Develop reproducible Python analysis and verification tools for wearable sensor algorithms. Work includes numerical checks, sensor-data audits, capture-timing analysis, and evaluation design for a wearable-device prototype.

I investigate data provenance, participant identity, irregular capture cadence, and repeated readings before treating a dataset as suitable for model development. The work connects algorithm analysis with explicit software checks and participant-separated evaluation design.
